scope: Loaded ScanProjectiles and native world-object descriptor domain

checks: 180 loaded projectile cases and 128 direct precision cases

limits: Synthetic native comparisons are not independent gameplay annotations.
Convenience WorldObjectPrecision remains bounded; loaded scans use NativePrecisionDescriptor.
Non-finite arithmetic values are retained; NaN sign/payload is not asserted across targets.
Native loops with impractically large overflowed limits are not executed by the Go oracle; signed-width edge cases are checked using the direct position primitive.
Keyframe band recovery remains heuristic; mobile trajectory endpoints are not impact/death events.
